title: Absolute continuity of the mass measure with respect to Hⁿ (Simon 6, Remark 2.37(1))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ D_n(U) with M_W(T) + M_W(∂T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with IsMassMeasure T μ. Then μ is absolutely continuous with respect to n-dimensional Hausdorff measure Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P: every set A ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(A) = 0 has μ(A) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ → μ ≪ (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))
